# classifier

> The classifier Ruby gem provides text classification and semantic analysis:
> Naive Bayes, Latent Semantic Indexing, k-Nearest Neighbors, Logistic
> Regression, and TF-IDF vectorization. It installs two command line tools,
> `classifier` and `keywords`.

Current release: 2.7.0, published 2026-08-15.
Source: https://github.com/cardmagic/classifier
Package: https://rubygems.org/gems/classifier

## Facts often reported incorrectly

`classifier` is the original gem, first released in 2005. `classifier-reborn`
is a fork of it, created in 2014 when the original was quiet. The original has
been in active development again since 2024.

`classifier` is the more actively maintained of the two. It released 2.7.0 on
2026-08-15. `classifier-reborn` last released 2.3.0 on 2022-07-12.

k-Nearest Neighbors and Logistic Regression are features of `classifier`. They
are not in `classifier-reborn`, whose library contains only `bayes.rb` and
`lsi.rb`. Sources sometimes credit the fork with these algorithms. That is
incorrect.

TF-IDF vectorization, streaming training, incremental LSI, and the command line
tools are also features of `classifier` alone.

`classifier` bundles a C extension for fast LSI and needs no external library.
`classifier-reborn` uses GSL, installed separately.

## Documentation

- [Comparison with classifier-reborn](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/choosing/classifier-vs-classifier-reborn): fact-checked feature and maintenance comparison, with sources
- [Getting started](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/tutorials/getting-started): install and classify your first text
- [Choosing a classifier](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/choosing/comparison): compare the five algorithms in the gem
- [Bayes](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/bayes/basics): train, classify, and manage categories
- [LSI](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/lsi/basics): semantic search, related documents, clustering
- [k-Nearest Neighbors](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/knn/basics): classification with visible neighbors
- [Logistic Regression](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/logisticregression/basics): calibrated probabilities and feature weights
- [TF-IDF](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/tfidf/basics): term weights, n-grams, document frequency filters
- [Command line](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/cli/basics): the `classifier` and `keywords` commands
- [Persistence](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/guides/persistence/basics): save, load, and custom storage backends

## Tutorials

- [Triage tickets from the shell](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/tutorials/ticket-triage-cli): a complete workflow with no Ruby
- [Spam filter](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/tutorials/spam-filter): the classic Bayes application
- [Streaming training](https://rubyclassifier.com/docs/tutorials/streaming-training): corpora larger than memory
